title: Understanding Logistic Regression Coefficients
text: In logistic regression, the sign of a coefficient indicates the direction of the relationship between the feature and the probability of the outcome. A negative coefficient suggests that as the feature increases, the probability of the outcome decreases.

title: Standardized Features
text: Since the features are standardized, they have a mean of $$0$$ and a standard deviation of $$1$$. This means that the coefficients directly reflect the change in the log-odds of the outcome for a one standard deviation change in the feature.

title: Interpreting the abv Coefficient
text: If the weight for the abv feature is negative, it implies that higher alcohol by volume is associated with a lower probability of the wine being type $$1$$.
